about: The engine's taps (models/deepseek41/bundle/src/taps.rs and taps/text.rs, built with the diagnostic-taps feature), in program order. The first entry whose name matches applies; {nn} is a two-digit layer.

Names follow docs/reference-runner.md ("Taps and tapdiff"); models/deepseek41/reference.py `taps` maps the same names onto the vendor modules: embed.out the embedding; L<nn>.in.streams the block's four mHC streams; x.hc.attn.{pre,post,comb} and x.hc.ffn.{pre,post,comb} a block's mHC coefficients; x.hc.attn and x.hc.mlp the attn_norm and ffn_norm inputs; attn.in and mlp.in their outputs; x.latent the normalized window latent before RoPE and quantization; attn.out and mlp.out the all-reduced sublayer outputs; router.weights and router.ids the gate's outputs; L<nn>.out the block's output streams; final.x.hc.head the norm's input; final.norm its output.

enc.vision.out is the aligner's output on its image cells in raster order, without the learned start, newline and end rows (reference.py taps the aligner), from rank 0's media arena; enc.vision.B<nn>.out is each vision block's output rows in patch order, read back by the shared encoder runtime, and enc.vision.B<nn>.in a transformer's input rows, written by the engine only.
Every tap is replicated and written from rank 0 after its stage, for prefill phases only. The text taps' widths follow the geometry, so their entries leave cols out.

taps.name: enc.vision.out
taps.layout: hidden; the aligner's image cells on the encoder row axis

taps.name: enc.vision.B{nn}.in
taps.layout: F32 residual stream (f32-pairs.v1); a transformer's input rows; written by the engine only

taps.name: enc.vision.B{nn}.out
taps.layout: F32 residual stream (f32-pairs.v1); a vision block's output rows in patch order

taps.name: L{nn}.router.weights
taps.layout: top-k weights, in the order of router.ids
